claims.claim: Entegris reported Q2 2026 net sales of $883.2M versus $792.4M a year earlier, GAAP gross margin of 47.6% versus 44.4%, and GAAP operating margin of 18.6% versus 13.4%.

Management said improving semiconductor demand and accelerating customer capital investment drove double-digit growth across both unit- and capex-related businesses and that results exceeded guidance across key metrics.

risks.risk: Semiconductor capital-spending cyclicality can reverse quickly; current acceleration does not prove durable demand through a downcycle.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not quantify customer concentration or isolate advanced-node exposure sufficiently to prove the durability of the mix shift.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 combined year-over-year sales growth with material GAAP margin expansion and management's statement that key metrics exceeded guidance is evidence of improving operating execution alongside the semiconductor upcycle.

risks.risk: Execution evidence is partly entangled with favorable industry demand; future margin resilience under weaker wafer-fab spending remains unproven.

unknowns.unknown: No independent foundry/customer capex source was added in this pass.
